sources.title: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) for LLMs - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is a method of adapting a pre-trained language model using a smaller dataset containing labeled examples. The model learns to produce the desired output for a given input, improving its performance on a specific task or type of instruction.

sources.title: From SFT to GRPO: A Practical Guide to Modern LLM Fine-Tuning ...
sources.snippet: Learn how SFT, DPO, PPO, GRPO, PEFT, LoRA, and QLoRA fit together in modern LLM post-training, when to use each technique, and how to combine them effectively.

sources.title: LLM Alignment: Complete Guide on SFT, RLHF, DPO, and GRPO
sources.snippet: Introduction Language model alignment (LLM Alignment) has become one of the most critical challenges in modern artificial intelligence. A pre-trained language model like GPT-4, Claude, or Llama, however powerful, is not naturally aligned with human intentions, ethical values, or desirable behaviors. Without alignment, these models can generate toxic content, provide dangerous instructions, or ...

sources.title: Hands-on SFT Practical: Fine-tuning a Model - apxml.com
sources.snippet: This practical guide demonstrates the steps to perform SFT on a pre-trained language model. The exercise utilizes libraries from the Hugging Face ecosystem, specifically transformers, datasets, and trl (Transformer Reinforcement Learning), which significantly simplifies the process.

sources.title: SFT Fine-Tuning: Transform Base LLM to Chat Model (3-Stage Guide - 2025)
sources.snippet: Complete SFT fine-tuning guide for 2025: Transform base LLMs into instruction-following chat models using Supervised Fine-Tuning. Learn 3-stage evolution (base → instruct → chat), dataset selection (Alpaca 52K, Dolly-15k, Open-Orca 4.2M), LoRA optimization (3-10x faster, 70% cost reduction), training costs ($10-20 for 7B on A100). Includes SFT vs RLHF comparison and best practices.
